model.title: Route 66 National Historic Trail Designation Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would officially designate Route 66 as a National Historic Trail under federal law, recognizing its historical significance. It aims to provide protections and management for this iconic highway corridor while allowing for preservation efforts and public access to its historic sites and landmarks.
